io.github.rulin132.ChatGPT.appid-url-not-reachable: The linter expects github.com/rulin132/chatgpt to exist for this app id, but the repo is named chatgpt-flatpak. Permanent unless a stub repo is created at that name.
io.github.rulin132.ChatGPT.finish-args-own-name-org.freedesktop.Sta: Chromium registers its tray item under this exact name (sandbox pid is always 2). Without owning it the DBus proxy rejects the registration and the tray icon never appears.
